parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm at about 75 bpm with normal axis and narrow QRS, and no ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria in any lead (ST segments are near baseline with upright T waves, and the deep S waves in V2–V3 only suggest a normal-variant voltage pattern), so this does not support acute STEMI.
